title: Chatham Village House Entrance in Snow, Sepia Snapshot, Pittsburgh PA 1940s
back_text_transcription: Early May snow part of our home Chatham Village Pittsburgh, Pa. Taken by Hardin Hall 30-I 46
description: A vintage sepia snapshot showing the entrance and garden walkway of a home in Chatham Village, Pittsburgh, Pennsylvania, covered in a light early May snowfall. Chatham Village, established in 1932 as a pioneering model garden community in the Mount Washington neighborhood of Pittsburgh, is celebrated for its Georgian Revival architecture and integrated landscape design.
